# Root admission validation

Four new seam tests cover skipped borrowed non-Send reasons with zero metadata,
preflight-before-observation order, original directory/file metadata, unchanged
error payload identity and callback panic before backend access. Missing-API TDD
failure is retained. Existing backend tests cover final symlinks/raw paths/errors.
Debug/Release, clippy/fmt, HC and SpecPM receipts include source/tool/output identity.
Dependency-reference and historical metadata-ID warnings remain non-fatal.

Host owns policy/guards, callback effects, scheduling/status/finalization. This is
not full generic startup, runtime conformance acceptance, a live cloud test, or a
speedup/RAM claim. Historical session receipts remain historical.
